Method of Attack: Dependency confusion attack by publishing counterfeit packages with the same names as private internal packages
Preinstall scripts exfiltrating identifying information via DNS requests
Automatic execution of malicious scripts during build process without user action
Attack Vector: Publishing malicious packages with identical names to private internal packages on public repositories (npm, PyPI, RubyGems)
Exploitation of package manager design flaw prioritizing public packages over private ones
Automatic dependency resolution and installation in build pipelines
Indicators of Compromise: Callback alerts containing IP, username, and home directory information
